queries: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), status_averages AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event_averages GROUP BY status) SELECT status, avg_remaining, avg_overspend_rate, avg_remaining / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM status_averages) AS relative_avg_remaining FROM status_averages;
